intro: Incantations from the Nether is a grimoire of demonic magic held by the Searing Blade cultists lurking beneath Orgrimmar. Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras, seek to claim the tome to harness its fel knowledge for the Forsaken.

p: Beneath the red stone streets of Orgrimmar, the Searing Blade—a subterranean sect tied to the Shadow Council—operates in the fiery tunnels of Ragefire Chasm. Among their darkest treasures is the Incantations from the Nether, a spellbook laden with demonic rites bestowed by agents of the Burning Legion. While the cultists use its vile secrets to plot treason within the Orcish capital, word of the text reached far across the sea to the royal quarters of Undercity.
